title: Air Space Intelligence won an $875M, 12-year FAA contract to develop AI tools that map flight trajectories and identify areas of congestion to reduce delays (Allyson Versprille/Bloomberg)
summary: Allyson Versprille / Bloomberg: Air Space Intelligence won an $875M, 12-year FAA contract to develop AI tools that map flight trajectories and identify areas of congestion to reduce delays — Air Space Intelligence Inc. won a US government contract to develop artificial intelligence technologies for managing flight traffic …
